name: Bloodsport Duel SiMulator
source:
In a world where the rich are functionally immortal, Ember signs up for underground duels to the death to make ends meet. As she navigates this cutthroat world of deadly competition between cyborgs, she draws the personal attention of her manager and the league's longtime reigning champion— both individuals who take great delight in the suffering they cause in the arena. 

Will Ember choose to confront and embrace the cruelty that caused her past relationships to fail, or will she die on her way to becoming the champion?

[From [url=https://hamaonoverdrive.itch.io/bdsim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个富人永生的世界里，安布尔报名参加地下决斗以维持收支平衡。当她在这个机器人之间致命竞争的残酷世界中航行时，她引起了她的经理和联盟长期卫冕冠军的个人注意——这两个人都对自己在竞技场上造成的痛苦感到非常高兴。

安布尔会选择面对并接受导致她过去的关系失败的残酷，还是会在成为冠军的路上死去？

[来自[url=https://hamaonoverdrive.itch.io/bdsim]itch.io[/url]]
